verdict.rationale: Polar documents no-code Checkout Links you can configure in the dashboard and share within minutes, plus embedded checkout and a full Checkout Session API, and as Merchant of Record it handles tax/compliance so a founder can go live and accept a real card payment quickly; a sandbox with Stripe test cards lets you validate the flow before going live. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on account confirming an actual first live payment within 24 hours, and no explicit mention of KYC/onboarding approval time which could affect same-day activation.
